object/get:
def _get(o, p, d=None):
    for s in p.replace(chr(92) + '.', chr(0)).split('.'):
        s = s.replace(chr(0), '.')
        if isinstance(o, dict) and s in o: o = o[s]
        elif isinstance(o, list) and s.isdigit() and int(s) < len(o): o = o[int(s)]
        else: return d
    return o
object/has:
def _has(o, p):
    for s in p.replace(chr(92) + '.', chr(0)).split('.'):
        s = s.replace(chr(0), '.')
        if isinstance(o, dict) and s in o: o = o[s]
        elif isinstance(o, list) and s.isdigit() and int(s) < len(o): o = o[int(s)]
        else: return False
    return True

object/omit: def _omit(o, ks): return {k: v for k, v in o.items() if k not in ks}

math/ln: def _ln(x): return None if x <= 0 else math.log(x)

cases.note: renderModels true writes the entity as model code instead of importing it. Control: ports-call, the same program importing the shell's models.

warnings: T.GO: persist is called on the ports object

cases.note: numberIntForm writes the integers and numberForm the other numbers, in expressions and in the entityReadDefault default. Control: number-int-form-neutral, the same program with the neutral forms.
Control of number-int-form: the default forms write every number as its JSON text.
payloadFieldOrder sorted builds the emit payload by field name, not in the order of the object literal. Control: payload-field-order-declared.
Control of payload-field-order-sorted: the default order is the one of the object literal.
mapEmpty writes a map literal with no pair, in an expression and as the config of a trait with no knob, and leaves a map with pairs alone. Control: map-empty-unset.
Control of map-empty: with no mapEmpty an empty map is mapOpen followed by mapClose.

stringEscapes replaces text inside a string literal after the standard escaping, so a program string that already holds the replacement text round-trips (the string backslash dollar stays two characters in the program and four in the output). Control: string-escapes-neutral.
stringEscapes entries run one after another in sorted key order: a becomes b, then b becomes X. Control: string-escapes-neutral.
Control of string-escapes: with no stringEscapes a string is its JSON text.
fileHeader is the first text of the file, followed by sectionGap, before the imports. Control: file-header-neutral.
Control of file-header: with no fileHeader the file starts with the imports.
entityNames renames the entity in the constructor and in the model imports and leaves a name it does not list. Control: entity-names-neutral.
Control of entity-names: with no entityNames the .lolo name is written.
entityNames renames the model class when renderModels is true, as well as the constructor. Control: entity-names-models-neutral.
Control of entity-names-models.
